usageNotes: Use this endpoint to poll the completion state of any async Proxmox operation (VM start, backup, migration, etc.) after receiving its UPID. The target node must be online and reachable; the UPID is node-scoped, so always query the node that originated the task. Non-owners need 'Sys.Audit' on '/nodes/<node>'; task owners can read their own status without that privilege.

examples.summary: Check the status of a VM backup task on pve1

tips: When 'status' is 'stopped', check 'exitstatus' — 'OK' means success; any other value (e.g. 'ERROR') means the task failed.
Poll this endpoint on a short interval (2–5 s) after triggering long-running operations like backups, migrations, or snapshot creation rather than assuming instant completion.
The UPID encodes the originating node; querying a different node for a UPID it did not create will return a 404 or error — always use the node from the UPID string itself.
